name: bare-fetch

exports.name: fetch
signatures: fetch(input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response>
exports.description: Perform an HTTP or HTTPS request. `input` may be a URL string, a `URL` object, or a `Request` object. `init` is an optional options object.

params.name: input
params.description: The URL string, `URL`, or `Request` to fetch.

params.name: init
params.description: Request options; `body`, `signal`, and `agent` default to `null`, `method` to `'GET'`, and `headers` to an empty `Headers`.

returns.description: A promise that resolves with the `Response` once the response headers arrive.

throws.condition: `input` or a redirect `Location` is not a valid URL.
the URL protocol is neither `http:` nor `https:`.
more than 20 redirects were followed.
the underlying request failed or the connection was lost.
